## What & why

What you want added or changed, and the problem it solves.

## Roadmap fit

Does this map to an existing entry in [docs/roadmap/](../../docs/roadmap/)?
If yes, name it (e.g. "Branch 9", "Phase 10"). If it's new scope, say
which tier it belongs in — see the tier table in
[README.md](../../README.md) and [docs/architecture/1.0/core.md](../../docs/architecture/1.0/core.md)
for the test used to place a new service in the right one.

## Proposed approach

Sketch of how this would work, if you have one. Not required for an
early-stage idea.

## Docs affected

Any of [docs/roadmap/](../../docs/roadmap/), [docs/architecture/](../../docs/architecture/),
or [docs/schema.md](../../docs/schema.md) that would need updating alongside
the implementation — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md#docs-stay-in-sync-with-code).
